en: Guide Notes
zh_TW: 攻略筆記

en: Sure
zh_TW: 確定

en: Not sure
zh_TW: 我不確定

en: Proven wrong
zh_TW: 被推翻

en: Confirmed
zh_TW: 證實

en: 172 steps down. The first trap is arrows.
zh_TW: 地下一百七十二階，第一個陷阱是射箭。

en: No arrows. A bucket of dirty water fell from the ceiling.
zh_TW: 沒有箭。天花板掉下一桶髒水。

en: Daylight City is dead. The plague turned everyone into monsters.
zh_TW: 白晝城是被瘟疫吞沒的死城，所有人都成了怪物。

en: They are alive down here. They buy water with days of their lives.
zh_TW: 下面的人還活著。他們用壽命買水。

en: That door cannot be opened. Nothing behind it.
zh_TW: 那扇門不可互動，後面什麼都沒有。

en: Behind it: a table, two children, and onions growing in a broken helmet.
zh_TW: 門後面是一張桌、兩個孩子，和一盆種在碎頭盔裡的蔥。

en: There is a purifying furnace at the entrance.
zh_TW: 入口有一座淨化爐。

en: The furnace is empty and long cold. Someone hangs laundry on it.
zh_TW: 爐子是空的，冷了很多年。有人在上面晾衣服。

en: The lord of the city is the Year-Eating Usurper. Weak point: the heart.
zh_TW: 城主是「食歲的僭王」。弱點：心臟。

en: Isa, the city's lord. A metal brace on his right leg. He asked about Sheila's hand.
zh_TW: 伊薩，城主。右腿金屬支架。問了席菈的手。

en: Fastest route: light the furnace, burn the lower streets, kill the lord. Six seconds.
zh_TW: 最快路線：點燃淨化爐，燒光下層街區，再殺城主。六秒。

en: The monsters were never burned by players. The whole city paid for that strike.
zh_TW: 怪物不是被玩家燒死的。是整座城替玩家付了那一擊的費用。

en: Misha
zh_TW: 彌夏

en: Innkeeper
zh_TW: 酒館老闆

en: Leo's letter
zh_TW: 黎歐的信

en: Chapter One
zh_TW: 第一章

en: The Door Beyond the Guide
zh_TW: 攻略之外的門

en: To be continued — Daylight City is still being built.
zh_TW: 待續——白晝城還在製作中。

en: The Door Beyond the Guide
zh_TW: 攻略之外的門

en: Find Sheila by the wounded
zh_TW: 去傷者那邊找席菈

en: Night has fallen. Sit down to dinner with Sheila and Misha
zh_TW: 入夜了，跟席菈、彌夏一起吃飯

en: Draw the guide you remember at the small table
zh_TW: 到小桌子把記得的攻略畫成地圖

en: Go to the cellar under the pear seller's house
zh_TW: 去梨販家的地窖

en: The wounded are all settled. Thirty-one people didn't come back.
zh_TW: 傷者都安置好了。三十一個人沒有回來。

en: (A woman in an oversized dark-green coat sets a clock with no hands on the table.) Don't ring it.
zh_TW: （一個穿著過長墨綠外衣的女人，把一台沒有指針的鐘放上桌。）不要敲它。

en: Do I look like someone who loves ringing bells?
zh_TW: 我看起來很愛敲鐘嗎？

en: (She opens the case. No spring inside — a white stone, slowly beating.) There's a city underground. The kingdom sealed it off seventeen years ago.
zh_TW: （她拆開鐘殼。裡面不是發條，是一塊慢慢跳動的白石。）地下有座城，被王國封起來十七年了。

en: Daylight City.
zh_TW: 白晝城。

en: So the patrol does know. I'm Misha. Eat with me tonight, and I'll tell you the rest.
zh_TW: 巡邏隊果然知道。我叫彌夏。今晚一起吃飯，我把話說完。

en: (She takes out a letter, worn thin, patched at the corners four times.) My brother Leo sent this last year. It came down the underground river, inside a fish.
zh_TW: （她拿出一封信，紙磨得快透明，邊角補了四次。）我弟弟黎歐去年寄來的。走地下河，裝在魚肚子裡。

en: Sis, I'm taller than you now. Don't send sugar, it melts. Send salt. Also, the clock has been running slow lately.
zh_TW: 姊，我現在比你高了。別寄糖，會化。寄鹽。還有，鐘最近走得很慢。

en: What do you want from us?
zh_TW: 你要我們做什麼？

en: Put the clapper back. The town up here is the seal; the city down there is its fuel. Once the bell rings nine times, the seal starts burning them up. Within seven days, everyone on the register down there will die.
zh_TW: 把鐘舌裝回去。上面的鎮是封印，下面的城是燃料。鐘敲滿九下，封印就開始把下面的人當柴燒。七天之內，下面登記過的人全都會死。

en: (Her left hand slowly covers the silver badge on her chest.) How do you know that?
zh_TW: （她的左手慢慢壓住胸前的銀徽章。）你怎麼知道？

en: I used to build bells like this for the kingdom.
zh_TW: 我替王國造過這種鐘。

en: (He sets down three bowls of soup with no meat. When he sees you he pauses, then puts yours down hard.) Soup.
zh_TW: （他端來三碗沒有肉的湯。看見你的時候停了一下，把你那碗放得很重。）湯。

en: (Once he's gone.) I took the clapper out. Then it fell into a crack.
zh_TW: （等老闆走遠。）鐘舌被我拆了。後來掉進裂縫。

en: Good news: it belongs down there anyway. Bad news: I'd planned three months to smuggle the tools in. Now we have six and a half days.
zh_TW: 好消息，它本來就該回下面。壞消息——我原本打算花三個月偷運工具。現在我們只有六天半。

en: (Sheila picks up the spoon with her left hand. Two tries. The soup ends up all over the table.)
zh_TW: （席菈用左手拿起湯匙，試了兩次，湯全灑在桌上。）

en: Hold the spoon for her
zh_TW: 替她拿湯匙

en: Don't move. Let her be.
zh_TW: 不動，等她自己來

en: (She raps the back of your hand with the spoon handle.) A hurt right hand doesn't mean both of them are useless.
zh_TW: （她用湯匙柄敲了一下你的手背。）右手受傷，不代表兩隻都廢了。

en: (Misha swaps Sheila's bowl for a cup with a handle and slides it in front of her.)
zh_TW: （彌夏把席菈的湯碗換成有把手的杯子，推到她面前。）

en: (Sheila looks at her.) ...Thank you.
zh_TW: （席菈看了她一眼，低聲說。）……謝謝。

en: (That night you draw every route you know onto paper — the traps, the monsters, every supply you could find.)
zh_TW: （那晚你把知道的路線全畫在紙上：陷阱、怪物、能找到的補給。）

en: Where did you learn all this?
zh_TW: 你從哪裡知道這些？

en: From another life.
zh_TW: 另一段人生。

en: (She doesn't laugh.) In that life, how many people died today?
zh_TW: （她沒有笑。）那段人生裡，今天死了多少人？

en: None. It was only a game there.
zh_TW: 沒有。那裡只是遊戲。

en: (She's quiet for a long time.) Mark the parts you're not sure about, too.
zh_TW: （她很久沒說話。）把你不確定的地方也標出來。

en: (You pick up the pen. In the end, you circle the whole map.)
zh_TW: （你拿起筆。最後，整張地圖都被你圈了起來。）

en: The map on the table
zh_TW: 桌上的地圖

en: Mark the parts you're not sure about.
zh_TW: 把你不確定的地方也標出來。

en: That's all
zh_TW: 就這樣

en: (You pick up the pen and circle a few places. Sheila looks at the map and says nothing.)
zh_TW: （你拿起筆，圈了幾個地方。席菈看著那張地圖，什麼也沒說。）

en: (You hold the pen over the paper for a long time. You don't circle anything.)
zh_TW: （你拿著筆，在紙上停了很久。一個圈也沒畫。）

en: Walk through North Street by daylight
zh_TW: 白天走一趟昨晚的北街

en: Ada is waiting at the pear seller's cellar
zh_TW: 艾妲在梨販家的地窖門口等你

en: Go down into the cellar
zh_TW: 走下地窖

en: It's clearer by daylight. Where the roofs fell in, the snow has already covered half the tiles.
zh_TW: 白天看，比昨晚清楚。屋頂塌下去的地方，雪已經蓋住一半的瓦片。

en: Ada was here at first light. She wrote down the name from every house.
zh_TW: 艾妲天一亮就來過了。每一戶的名字，她都抄下來了。

en: In the guide, this street was just a cutscene.
zh_TW: 在攻略裡，這條街只是一段過場動畫。

en: Then remember that it isn't. Come on. She's waiting at the cellar.
zh_TW: 那就記住它不是。走吧，她在地窖等。

en: When you come back, I'm going to sue you.
zh_TW: 你回來的時候，我要告你。

en: You forgot your own father. Don't you forget me. When you come back, I'm going to sue you.
zh_TW: 你連你爸都忘了，別把我忘了。你回來的時候，我要告你。

en: I know.
zh_TW: 我知道。

en: Don't die down there. The dead don't rebuild anyone's house.
zh_TW: 別死在下面。死人不會替人重建房子。

en: (Ada pushes a round brass oil lamp into your hands. It's still warm.)
zh_TW: （艾妲把一盞圓肚的銅油燈塞進你手裡。燈還是熱的。）

en: The next morning.
zh_TW: 隔天早上。

en: Go to the door at the bottom of the stairs
zh_TW: 走到樓梯底的那扇門

en: Press {key} — toss a stone ahead
zh_TW: 按 {key}　往前丟一塊石頭試探

en: Wait.
zh_TW: 等一下。

en: In the guide, the first trap on these stairs is right here. Arrows.
zh_TW: 照攻略，這段樓梯的第一個陷阱就在前面：射箭。

en: In the guide, the first trap is right here. Arrows. ...That's one I marked not sure.""
zh_TW: 照攻略，第一個陷阱就在前面：射箭。……這條我標了「不確定」。

en: Then don't test it with your feet.
zh_TW: 那就別用腳去試。

en: (Misha hugs the clock tighter and steps behind Sheila.)
zh_TW: （彌夏把鐘抱緊，躲到席菈後面。）

en: (No arrows.)
zh_TW: （沒有箭。）

en: (Instead, a bucket of dirty water drops from the ceiling — right where I would have stepped.)
zh_TW: （天花板卻掉下一桶髒水，潑在我剛剛要踩的地方。）

en: (Instead, a bucket of dirty water drops from the ceiling. Right on my head.)
zh_TW: （天花板卻掉下一桶髒水。從我頭上淋下來。）

en: (Sheila glances at me and says nothing.)
zh_TW: （席菈看了我一眼，什麼都沒說。）

en: ...Figures.
zh_TW: ……果然。

en: (From deep down the stairs comes a child's laughter, then an adult's scolding.)
zh_TW: （樓梯深處傳來小孩的笑聲，接著是大人的喝斥。）

en: There are people down there.
zh_TW: 下面有人。

en: In the guide, there's nothing down there but monsters.
zh_TW: 攻略上，下面只有怪物。

en: In the guide, there's nothing down there but monsters. ...I marked that one too.
zh_TW: 攻略上，下面只有怪物。……這條我也標了不確定。

en: Then let's go see what kind of monster laughs.
zh_TW: 那就下去看看，什麼樣的怪物會笑。

en: Kord
zh_TW: 柯德

en: Follow Kord into Daylight City
zh_TW: 跟著柯德走進白晝城

en: From up top?
zh_TW: 地上來的？

en: (I nod.)
zh_TW: （我點頭。）

en: (He sees Sheila's badge, and the smile leaves his face.)
zh_TW: （他看見席菈的徽章，臉上的笑消失了。）

en: We've already paid this year.
zh_TW: 我們今年已經交過了。

en: (The door behind him is half open. A table inside, two children, and a pot of scallions growing in a broken helmet.)
zh_TW: （他身後的門半開著。裡面有一張桌，兩個孩子，一盆種在碎頭盔裡的蔥。）

en: (On my map, that door is marked: cannot be opened.)
zh_TW: （我的地圖上，那扇門標著：不可互動。）

en: (On my map, that door is marked: cannot be opened. Next to it, a question mark I drew myself.)
zh_TW: （我的地圖上，那扇門標著：不可互動。旁邊有一個我自己畫的問號。）

en: (Sheila takes off her silver badge and puts it in her pocket.)
zh_TW: （席菈摘下銀徽，放進口袋。）

en: We're here to fix the bell.
zh_TW: 我們來修鐘。

en: ...And you?
zh_TW: ……那你呢？

en: (Say nothing. Show him your empty hands.)
zh_TW: （什麼都不說，把空著的手攤開給他看。）

en: We're not here to take anything. We're here to help.
zh_TW: 我們不是來收東西的。我們是來幫忙的。

en: My map said this door doesn't open.
zh_TW: 我的地圖上說，這扇門打不開。

en: (He looks at your hands for a long time.) ...They're shaking.
zh_TW: （他盯著你的手看了很久。）……在發抖。

en: Everyone who comes down says that. Then they take something.
zh_TW: 下來的人都這麼說。說完就拿走一點東西。

en: A door that doesn't open? Doors are for people to go in and out of.
zh_TW: 打不開的門？門是給人進出的。

en: (He stares at Sheila. In the end, he lowers the fork a little.)
zh_TW: （男人盯著席菈，最後把叉子放低了一點。）
